stem.text: Which effect does increasing carbon dioxide concentration have on haemoglobin?

A.text: Haemoglobin is less efficient at taking up oxygen and less efficient at releasing oxygen.

B.text: Haemoglobin is less efficient at taking up oxygen and more efficient at releasing oxygen.

C.text: Haemoglobin is more efficient at taking up oxygen and less efficient at releasing oxygen.

D.text: Haemoglobin is more efficient at taking up oxygen and more efficient at releasing oxygen.
